screens.screen: home (عزبة): welcome card + quick actions grid
group financial system (النظام المالي): stats card + bills

notes: Material 3 theme from ColorScheme.fromSeed(#2E7D32); the generated tones (primary #3B6939, surface #F7FBF1, card #F1F5EB, FAB #BCF0B4) are computed by Flutter at runtime and are approximated here. Cairo is declared in pubspec but the theme never applies it (code comment: 'can add Cairo font later'), so the system font is drawn. On a 390pt-wide phone the home quick-action cards are tight (Card theme margin inside a square grid cell) - drawn as the code lays them out. Stats add up: 5 bills, 9600.00 total = 7200.00 paid + 2400.00 remaining = 75.0%; visible bills 6000.00 (75%) + 840.00 (100%). The group details page was skipped because its content is still hard-coded placeholders ('اسم المجموعة'). Percent sign position follows RTL bidi exactly as Flutter would render the same string.
